_note: ANTAR master config. Every locked decision lives here. Edit nothing by hand without telling the panel.

project.name: LUXE
project.meaning: luxury quote reels - pro human edits

lane.name: luxury-quotes
lane.definition: Luxury quote reels with premium clips, rectangular middle clean edges, different fonts by mood, phonk signature
lane.subject: luxury, quiet luxury, main character, motivation, hindi quotes

delivery.note: rate and pitch may be modulated per section at build time; the base is the sample you chose

type.rule: Multi-font: Khand for Hindi talking, Bebas for bold, Didot/Abril for luxury

gradient.note: static gradient on the font, lit from the middle, identical at both sizes

pacing.words_per_second_note: MEASURED, then CORRECTED. First measurement counted the synthesiser's front padding as speech and gave 2.633 w/s. Measured again over speech only - first word to last word - the true rate is 2.576 w/s. The first figure would have put every script about 4 seconds too long.
pacing.band_derivation: band = wps x (target seconds - silence - loop gap) = 2.576 x 29.10 = 75.0, 2.576 x 39.10 = 100.7. Rounded to 75-101.
pacing.target_duration_note: The band is about the FINAL TRACK, which includes the 0.85s of silence before the payoff. Speech alone must fit inside target minus that silence.

audio.sub_bass_note: Muted through the payoff silence by a ramped envelope. A constant drone fills the hole and destroys the pause.

thresholds._note: MINIMAL INSTA CHECKS - No YT blocking gate
thresholds.note: Insta: no 85/100 score gate, no brightness 35-45 band, no title score. Only resolution, duration, safe zone center 80%, file size.

vault.lookalike_rule: Clips within this Hamming distance of an already-used clip count as the same clip.

rotation._note: Identity is fixed. Template rotates. No two consecutive videos may share more than 3 of these.

brain._note: The strongest model a key is entitled to must write every script. A weak answer must never stop the engine reaching a strong one.
brain.json_mode_note: Never requested. Groq validates the raw generation and a reasoning model's raw output carries a trace, so a good answer still 400s.

topics.title_length_note: The 40-60 rule is an ENGLISH rule - it is about display width, not character count. A Devanagari glyph averages ~1.3x the width of a Latin one at the same size, so 40-60 Latin chars is roughly 30-46 Devanagari chars. Band set to 30-48.

picture._note: How the picture stage finds footage. Everything here is a rule, not a preference.
picture.face_scan_note: Runs if opencv-python-headless is installed. Without it the search is still people-free but the pixels are not checked, and ANTAR says so on every run.
picture.size_note: the smallest file that is still 1920 tall - 1080x1920 on Pexels - because a 720-wide clip stretched to the canvas is soft
